title: Email provider sending limits
note: Figures are copied from each provider's own documentation on the date above. Providers change them without notice. A null value means the provider does not publish a figure, not that there is no limit.

providers.name: Google Workspace (Gmail)
providers.notes: Applied over a rolling 24 hours. After a limit is hit, sending is blocked for up to 24 hours.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online)
providers.notes: Recipient limit per message is customizable up to 1000. A tenant-level external recipient rate limit also exists; see the source page.

providers.name: Outlook.com
providers.notes: Microsoft says limits vary with usage history and are lower for non-subscribers, but publishes no figure for free accounts. A non-relationship recipient is someone you have never emailed before. A new account starts on a low quota that rises as it builds credibility.

providers.name: Zoho Mail
providers.notes: The external hourly limit is dynamic and depends on sender reputation, recipient engagement and contact quality.

providers.name: Hostinger Titan Email
providers.notes: The source page does not state a per-message recipient limit.

providers.name: GoDaddy Workspace Email
providers.notes: Figures come from search-engine summaries of GoDaddy's help page. GoDaddy returns 403 to automated requests, so we could not read the page ourselves on 2026-10-07. Treat as unconfirmed and check the source. A correction with a screenshot or quote is welcome.
